networking_scenarios.scope_condition: Fully offline game with no network services; excludes optional telemetry, leaderboards, update endpoints or online accounts.
LAN/local model avoids assuming centralized gameplay host, but client support, matchmaking, network compatibility and relay needs are not measured.
Separate servers/hosting, monitoring, authentication, security and operational maintenance are not supplied by itch.io.
A browser-hosted client connecting to external HTTPS services is a documented pattern, not an executable QA result.

buyer_unit_constraints: Browser game launches and multiplayer sessions are not purchasers.
Game binary hosted on itch.io is not proof that a separate server is online.
A game's platform purchase entitlement may persist after third-party online infrastructure stops operating.
limits: Published operator/moderator support replies from 2021–2025 may evolve; current account eligibility and backend provider pricing are not verified.
Game networking architecture determines whether a server is required; do not impose a fixed server bill on offline games.
No actual game binary, server process, player account or network endpoint has been tested.
An external host might offer a free tier or the author may self-host, but neither entails guaranteed operating cost of zero or reliability.
